name: Thermal Compensator Basin
core_rationale: Eleventh mercury-and-brass thermal expansion basin of Continent 02 where Krono's subterranean heat-exchanger tubes stabilize the eastern escapement mesas.
local_conflict: Pressurized mercury-piston constructs and thermal-scale beetles patrol the gleaming brass expansion manifolds.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Horologists in Bimetallic-Chronometer Hub say the eastern Thermal Compensator Basin rises and falls by two full meters between dawn and dusk as its mercury bellows breathe.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Concentric brass bellows-towers and silver thermal radiator fins shimmering beyond the eastern rim of Bimetallic Escapement Mesa.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What deep-crust geothermal spring feeds the primary heat exchanger of Thermal Compensator Basin?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-krono-clockmaker and scar-brass-faultline along the eastern thermal rim of Continent 02.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Concentric brass bellows-towers and silver thermal radiator fins breathing in rhythm with the desert sun.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: radiator catwalk and bellows valve metrics for 1.05m characters will be verified upon promotion to Draft.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: reserved as the eleventh District frontier on Continent 02 with zero filler maps.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Provides complete mystery_hook (in_world_rumor, visual_silhouette, unanswered_question) and empty grid_nodes.
